label: Possibly no concrete object exists: some world accessible from w has no concrete object
paraphrase: Conclusion of the subtraction argument (metaphysical nihilism about concreta), analyst formulation: some world accessible from w in the route's frame has no candidate that is concrete and exists there. It is the existing stage-one JointAbsence for the concrete-presence predicate. It does not say that nothing at all exists there: non-concrete candidates may exist.
